issues.title: 浏览器记录缓存和离线队列未按学校、账号隔离
issues.original_claim: cache_<table>/pending_<table> 等键不含租户与主体维度且无清理；切校或换账号后新主体读到旧主体缓存与待上传任务，任务发送时使用当前 token。
call_path: new StorageService(tableName) -> localCacheKey=cache_<table> / pendingRequestsKey=pending_<table> (Storage.js:61-62)
cache/queue read-write only on those global keys (Storage.js:500-504, 574, 593, 650-659)
AuthService.clearAuth only clears namespaced auth keys (AuthService.js:875-904)
queue headers taken from current token at send time (Storage.js:212-217)
getAll() returns local cache first (Storage.js:92-96)
key_evidence: deploy/DEPLOY_READINESS_REPORT.md:84-88 (single-origin deployment: https://foodsentinel.digifluidic.com, /api reverse-proxied same origin)
existing_protections: auth keys namespaced by schoolCode (TD-TenantIsolation)
server-side schema-per-tenant isolation
none for record cache / offline queue
issues.first_pass_note: First pass stated server schema isolation cannot compensate client-side misattribution; confirmed. Added precondition: isolation holds only because deployment is single-origin.
issues.trigger: Same browser same-origin: visit school A then switch to school B, or logout and login as another account
issues.impact: New subject sees previous subject's cached records (PII: inspector, canteen) and may upload A-school offline jobs with B-school credentials

reproduction.method: JSDOM same-origin URL switch (/a/ -> /b/) with real StorageService
reproduction.observed: New StorageService instance reads inspector=A校检测员 and pending job id=a-job; key template/source assertions pass (no cleanup point)

counter_evidence: Cross-device not affected
Would not apply if tenants were split across subdomains
Server data not modified; misattribution affects client display and subsequent writes

issues.title: 幂等缓存跨租户、跨主体命中，且先于写权限检查
issues.original_claim: 缓存键仅由 Idempotency-Key 与 body hash 组成；命中后直接返回缓存响应，跳过写权限检查；B 校 guest 可获得 A 校写请求的原始成功响应（非匿名，生产有前置认证）。
call_path: app.use('/api', recognitionRoutes) -> router.use(authenticateUser) (server.js:339 + recognitionRoutes.js:21)
app.use('/', recordRoutes) (server.js:347)
router.use('/api/records', idempotencyMiddleware) mounts BEFORE concrete routes (recordRoutes.js:20-21)
cacheKey = `${key}:${bodyHash(req.body)}` (idempotencyMiddleware.js:40)
cache hit -> res.status(...).json(cached.result); next() not called (idempotencyMiddleware.js:53-58)
concrete route chain authenticateUser + requireEditorOrAbove never executes (recordRoutes.js:280)
cached body = buildRecordPayload(record) with sample_info + result_data expanded (recordRoutes.js:333-337, recordNormalize.js:26-56)
existing_protections: production pre-auth via recognitionRoutes requires valid JWT (blocks anonymous)
requireGuestReadOnly covers GET reads only; write guard requireEditorOrAbove is bypassed by cache hit
issues.first_pass_note: First pass explicitly noted production pre-auth exists and did not claim anonymous bypass; confirmed.
issues.trigger: Authenticated subject (incl. guest/viewer) knows the exact Idempotency-Key AND byte-identical body (JSON.stringify semantics). Frontend key = sync_<ts>_<random5>_<type> (Storage.js:756-758); realistic path is same-device cross-school replay (offline queue / browser retry), not remote enumeration.
issues.impact: Cross-tenant, cross-subject read of A-school write response including unmasked inspector; authorization bypassed; no write produced (writes stays 1)

reproduction.method: Real express + real recordRoutes + real idempotencyMiddleware, controlled auth/guard counters
reproduction.observed: A-school operator POST -> 200, writes=1, auth=1, editor=1; B-school guest same key/body -> 200 with inspector=A校检测员, writes=1, auth=1(+0), editor=1(+0); replay from different URL + different subject also hits the same cache

counter_evidence: Requires exact key + body knowledge (not blind)
Body key order sensitive
Anonymous not possible due to production pre-auth
In-memory per-process store: multi-instance deployments reduce hit surface (idempotencyMiddleware.js:1-9)

issues.title: 停用学校未阻断内部登录和已签发 token
issues.original_claim: School.status 置 disabled 后，该校 User/Guest 仍可登录，已签发 token 继续可用。
call_path: PATCH /api/admin/schools/:code/status only updates School.status (schoolRoutes.js:404-422)
loginUser checks tenant user status/tenant binding only, never public.School (UserManager.js:313-390)
authenticateUser staff branch rechecks tenant User + revoked_tokens only (authMiddleware.js:364-386)
guest quick-access checks school existence + guest_enabled, not school.status (guestRoutes.js:88-99)
no DB trigger for School.status (role-audit-trigger.sql:92-96 only fires on UPDATE OF role ON User)
existing_protections: OpenAPI path rejects disabled school (openApiRoutes.js:163-167)
no revocation/token invalidation anywhere on school disable
issues.first_pass_note: No trigger or scheduled job provides a fallback; all revokeAllUserTokens call sites are user-level operations only.
issues.trigger: Platform super admin sets a school to disabled while its users/guests remain active
issues.impact: Disabled school keeps full internal access: login, read/write tenant data, obtain guest tokens

reproduction.observed: disable handler contains no revoke/session operations; login/auth/quick-access never read School.status; assertions pass

counter_evidence: Requires platform-admin action
Individual user accounts disabled separately are unaffected by this gap

issues.title: 退出及远程会话撤销没有绑定 JWT 有效性
issues.original_claim: logout 不做服务端撤销；Session.status=revoked 不影响 JWT 认证与刷新；已保存 token 仍可用。
call_path: POST /api/user/logout returns { success: true } only (userRoutes.js:191-194); frontend does call it (AuthService.js:348)
DELETE /api/session/:id and /others only set Session.status='revoked' (sessionRoutes.js:70-114)
authenticateUser queries Guest/User + revoked_tokens only, never Session (authMiddleware.js:322-397)
refresh-token checks revocation table + user status, never Session (userRoutes.js:287-314)
existing_protections: password change / reset / disable / role change / delete paths do write user_all revocation
logout and session-management UI are outside those paths
issues.trigger: Call logout, or revoke a session in the session management UI (including 'logout other devices')
issues.impact: UI shows logged-out/revoked while access token (<=30m) and refresh token (<=7d, renewable) remain valid; remote revoke cannot actually terminate a session

reproduction.method: source assertions; plus first-pass minimal repro that logout returns 200 with no revocation dependency
reproduction.observed: logout handler contains no revoke; auth/refresh paths contain no session table queries; session revoke only writes status

counter_evidence: Tokens are TTL-bounded
Password change and role change do provide real revocation paths

issues.title: 认证数据库故障时默认先放行两次请求
issues.original_claim: JWT 有效但 DB 回查失败时前两次请求 fail-soft 放行（沿用 token 内旧权限），第 3 次 503；成功回查清零计数。
call_path: authenticateUser staff branch: Promise.all([user.findUnique, isTokenRevoked]) (authMiddleware.js:366-373)
catch -> _onRecheckFailure(error) increments process counter (authMiddleware.js:429, 244-255)
below threshold: no response returned; req.user = token payload; next() called (authMiddleware.js:433-443)
threshold default 3 (authMiddleware.js:220); no deployment override in repo
_onRecheckSuccess resets counter on any successful lookup (authMiddleware.js:257-262)
existing_protections: consecutive-failure threshold gates 503
metric export getRecheckFailState()
documented availability trade-off (comments)
issues.trigger: Valid JWT signature + failing DB recheck (outage, pool exhaustion); interleaved successful lookups reset the counter and can prolong fail-soft windows
issues.impact: During outage window, token's stale role is honored for up to 2 requests per failure streak, including disabled/demoted accounts whose revocation record cannot be read; not read-only degradation

reproduction.method: Direct invocation of real authenticateUser with fake manager + failing fake DB
reproduction.observed: status sequence 200/200/503; first two calls invoked next() with req.user.role='admin' (stale token role); threshold=3

counter_evidence: Per-process counter; instances independent
Setting AUTH_DB_RECHECK_FAIL_THRESHOLD=1 removes the window (not set in deployment files)

issues.title: iat + 1 比较永久漏吊销同秒签发的旧 token
issues.original_claim: revoked_at >= to_timestamp(iat + 1) 使同一秒内先签发、后吊销的旧 token 永不命中该吊销记录。
call_path: isTokenRevoked SQL uses revoked_at >= to_timestamp($3 + 1) (authMiddleware.js:82-102)
used by authenticateUser (authMiddleware.js:334, 372) and refresh-token (userRoutes.js:287)
getTokenRevocationReason uses the same predicate (authMiddleware.js:111-129)
design comment documents iat+1 intent: avoid false revocation of a same-second re-issued token after password change (authMiddleware.js:74-79)
existing_protections: jti-precise revocation unaffected
iat+1 only affects user_all boundary second
issues.first_pass_note: Design intent (deliberate iat+1 to support same-second re-login after password change) is documented in code comments; first pass acknowledged this in its fix direction but did not weight the 1-second window in severity.
issues.trigger: Token iat and the user_all revocation timestamp fall in the same integer second (issue before revoke)
issues.impact: That token never matches the revocation record: access usable up to 30 min; leaked refresh token can be rotated if the user stays active (e.g. password-change scenario)
issues.impact_description_accurate: technically accurate; wording 'permanently leaked revocation' overstates the scale — it is a 1-second coincidence window for a single token

reproduction.method: semantic-equivalence probe of the SQL predicate + phase-1 PostgreSQL expression verification
reproduction.observed: iat=100s/revoked=100.5s -> hit=false; revoked=101.0s -> hit=true; iat=99s -> hit=true

counter_evidence: Common scenarios (revoke >1s after issue) work correctly
Affected window bounded by token TTL and subsequent revocation events
issues.priority_rationale: 1-second timing coincidence, documented design trade-off, impact bounded by TTL; recommend session-epoch redesign together with AUD-016 rather than raising severity

issues.title: 密码变更与会话吊销非原子，吊销失败仍返回成功
issues.original_claim: 改密/重置的密码写入与 revokeUserSessions 不在同一事务；吊销失败被捕获记录但不抛出，调用方仍返回成功。
call_path: changePassword: password update inside $transaction (UserManager.js:456-467) then revokeUserSessions called outside it (UserManager.js:469-472) then returns success (476-479)
resetPassword: user.update (662-669) -> revokeUserSessions (678) -> success (682-685)
revokeUserSessions catch: console.error + logSecurityEvent('REVOCATION_WRITE_FAILED') without rethrow (UserManager.js:195-211)
existing_protections: security event SECURITY:REVOCATION_WRITE_FAILED feeds alerting
no compensation or failure signal to the caller
issues.trigger: Password update succeeds, then writing public.revoked_tokens fails (DB hiccup/permission/connection)
issues.impact: API returns success while old access/refresh credentials stay valid; combined with AUD-014 the same outage makes auth recheck fail-soft, so old credentials actually remain usable

reproduction.method: Real UserManager.revokeUserSessions with a fake rootPrisma whose revocation write always throws
reproduction.observed: no throw propagated; SECURITY:REVOCATION_WRITE_FAILED emitted; source assertions confirm transaction-external call and unchecked result

counter_evidence: Failure leaves an alertable security event
Full DB outage usually fails the password update itself, but partial-success window exists

issues.title: 全局测试报告接口对任意已登录身份开放读写
issues.original_claim: /api/test-results 仅挂 authenticateUser，数据走全局 public Prisma；operator/viewer/guest 均可读写全局报告与管理操作。
call_path: createTestResultRoutes(userManager, prisma) mounted at /api/test-results with the global public prisma (server.js:333-335)
router.use(authenticateUser) only; no authorizeAdmin/authorizeRoles/requirePlatformSuperAdmin (testResultRoutes.js:73-74)
10 endpoints incl. 4 write endpoints (executions, cases/close, cases/mark-fixed, upload)
guest identities pass authenticateUser (authMiddleware.js:322-348); quick-access guests skip DB recheck
existing_protections: login required
upload mime/size/count limits (testResultRoutes.js:38-46)
issues.first_pass_note: Module header comment states it is a temporary test tool where any logged-in account may submit/view — declared design intent, not a hidden gap; this lowers the 'covert' component but not the over-exposure fact.
issues.impact: Read global test cases/executions/evidence images; write executions, close issues, mark fixed (quality-state pollution), upload files; data unrelated to requester's school

reproduction.method: source-path assertions (endpoint enumeration, guard absence, global prisma injection)
reproduction.observed: only authenticateUser; 10 endpoints enumerated; no role guard anywhere in router; assertions pass

counter_evidence: Limited to test-report module, no tenant business data
If module is not enabled in production the exposure surface is smaller (frontend entry not verified this round)
issues.priority_rationale: No tenant business data involved; module-level over-permission; still should be restricted to platform/authorized roles

issues.title: 学校删除后 OpenAPI 授权残留，可重新附着到同代码新学校
issues.original_claim: OpenApiGrant 以 school_code 文本关联、无外键与生命周期处理；删除学校不撤销 grant，同 code 重建后旧对接方仍可读新学校数据。
call_path: OpenApiGrant has school_code String only, unique(client_id, school_code), no School relation (schema.prisma:412-434)
hard delete transaction: ALTER SCHEMA RENAME + school.delete + recycle_bin insert; no OpenApiGrant handling (schoolRoutes.js:490-502)
POST /api/admin/schools -> provisionSchool; 409 only when schema already exists and not allowExisting (schoolRoutes.js:222-243, tenantProvisioner.js:120-133); no recycle_bin check
resolveSchool resolves grant by school_code + requires School.status='active' (openApiRoutes.js:139-148, 150-171)
key_evidence: backend/routes/adminOpenApiRoutes.js:358-379 (manual mitigation: unlisted schools get disabled on grant save)
existing_protections: school.status check at access time (404 while school row absent)
grant save disables schools missing from the request payload (manual action required)
issues.first_pass_note: First pass noted the temporary 404 protection; added the manual disable-on-save mitigation path and reachability conditions.
issues.trigger: Delete school -> recreate school with the same code (or restore from recycle bin) -> nobody re-saved the client's grants in between
issues.impact: Grant outlives the school lifecycle; the old third-party API key automatically regains read access to the new school's data

reproduction.method: source-path assertions (grant model, delete transaction, create path, resolve logic)
reproduction.observed: no School relation; delete transaction contains no openApiGrant reference; create path ignores recycle_bin; resolveSchool has status check but no generation/epoch check

counter_evidence: Requires delete + same-code recreate
If the code is never reused the gap is dormant
Saving the client's grant list after deletion disables the stale grant

arbitration_needed: AUD-015: accept documented 1s iat+1 trade-off (P2) vs adopt session/token epoch (root fix covering AUD-016)
AUD-002: move idempotency middleware after auth/authz vs keep position and bind cache key to tenant+subject+method+path with masked caching
AUD-017: restrict /api/test-results to platform roles vs introduce explicit scoped participants
AUD-010: should disabling a school revoke all school tokens (batch user_all cost, multi-instance consistency)
AUD-047: should same-code recreation inherit grants or force re-authorization with scope_version bump
systemic_root_causes: Cache keys lack tenant/subject dimensions and cache lookup precedes authorization (AUD-001 client-side, AUD-002 server-side)

Identity-state invalidation depends on explicit revocation writes that are neither mandatory nor covered on all paths, with distributed truth across User/School/Session/revoked_tokens (AUD-010, AUD-012, AUD-014, AUD-015, AUD-016)
Authorization entities are decoupled from resource lifecycle (AUD-047: grant keyed by reusable business code instead of immutable school id/generation)

new_findings_candidates.description: req.db injection (createTenantClient) sits outside authenticateUser's try/catch (authMiddleware.js:437-443); if tenant client construction throws (e.g. missing/invalid DATABASE_URL), a fail-soft-allowed request escapes as 500 instead of 503 and bypasses the fail-soft accounting.
new_findings_candidates.evidence: observed during probe bring-up: '缺少 DATABASE_URL，无法创建租户客户端' thrown from authMiddleware.js:441, escaping the try/catch
new_findings_candidates.severity_hint: low (configuration-dependent; Prisma lazy connect means DB outages do not trigger it)

new_findings_candidates.description: Idempotency store is a per-process Map (idempotencyMiddleware.js:6): multi-instance deployments do not share cache, so the same key may execute writes twice on different instances (idempotency guarantee does not hold horizontally).

not_executed: real-DB HTTP integration tests for AUD-010 / AUD-017 / AUD-047 (require isolated database + tenant fixtures)
any deployment, migration, restore or destructive operation
